conventions.source: staging/blender/2026-11-21_strikes/strikes.blend, scene ST, one station per slam look (x from 54000, 40 m apart, in the order earth, ice, fire, water, lightning, metal, life, dark, poison, light, wind). Built by script from the elements 2, 3 and 4 kits, combo kit v3, the arc strikes kit vfx_strikes_kit.fbx and the new vfx_slam_kit.fbx (vfxsl_thorn, vfxsl_sword, vfxsl_beam, vfxsl_crown).
conventions.made: 2026-11-21 by Claude through the Blender MCP connection.
conventions.axes: Unity axes, metres. Unity x = -Blender x, Unity y = Blender z (up), Unity z = -Blender y. Assumes the kit FBX files are imported with Bake Axis Conversion so each kit object's local axes are Unity axes.
conventions.origin: Every position is relative to the IMPACT POINT on the ground (y = 0): where the hammer head lands, the centre of the slam disc. Pieces with at_impact (placement i) and ribbons whose centre is impact are drawn about it. Bodies and the player carry their positions from the impact. Ribbons whose centre is "body k" are relative to that body's ground point. Offsets are world-aligned to the camera (it looks along Unity +z from -z, 55 degrees down); the slam is symmetric enough to turn with the player's facing.
conventions.groups: Pieces that share kit object and material are grouped. Each instance is [object, position, rotation_euler_deg, scale, placement], the KEY POSE (before any motion channel). group.motion lists the same objects in the same order.
conventions.instance.rotation_euler_deg: Unity Euler angles in degrees (Quaternion.Euler(x, y, z)), rounded to 1 degree.
conventions.instance.position: Metres, rounded to 1 mm: the piece's pivot (its base centre, the kit convention; the sword, dagger, funnel and whirl bands, rays and soft rays pivot at their origin: the guard, or the axis foot).
conventions.instance.scale: A number for uniform scale, else [x, y, z] in Unity local axes.
conventions.instance.placement: g = on the ground, b = on or around a body, i = about the impact point.
conventions.group.kit_object: The object inside group.kit. A kit of enemy_model means a second skin of the enemy model itself (stone, black) shown over it in the given window; unity_shader_mockup means a shell to build as a shader on the real model.
conventions.group.material: The material the piece wears in the render (shared meshes are re-coloured per piece). Flat emission bands, as pass 2.
conventions.timing: animated. Every piece is keyed at 20 fps; time 0 is frame 7 (frames 1-6 are a 0.3 s lead-in), and each timeline ends with 0.5 s of settle.
conventions.motion: One entry per instance (same order): verb, visible [appear, vanish] s (a vanish of 9 or more means it stays), delay = appear time, duration, easing, and the channels: path = [[t, offset (Unity axes, world-aligned), easing into this key]], scale_keys = [[t, multiplier on the key-pose scale (Unity local x, y, z), easing]], spin = {axis (Unity), keys [[t, degrees, easing]]} applied as Quaternion.AngleAxis(degrees, axis) * keyRotation about the pivot, orbit = {centre (Unity, from the origin), keys [[t, degrees, easing]]} applied last about the vertical through the centre, follow_body = the body index whose motion the piece rides on. Before the first key a channel holds its first value, after the last its last. Easings: linear, out = 1-(1-x)^2, in = x^2, inout = smoothstep, outback = overshoot (c = 1.70158), step = jump at the key. Angles are in Unity's sense.
conventions.bodies: The enemy model (enemy_husk stand-in) per body with its own motion (path, scale_keys, spin, spin2 applied after spin); body 0 is the one the reaction lands on. The stand-ins face the player.
conventions.lights: None: every look is unlit beyond the scene sun.
conventions.ribbons: Curve ribbons (wind curls, lightning arcs, floor combs, chains of light) are not kit meshes: each lists its points (Unity axes, metres, relative to its centre), width_m, radius_profile (taper = thin tail to full head scaled by taper_tail_head; needle = thin at both ends; flat = even), material and ink. Build them as a tube or flat ribbon along the points with the ink outline.

verbs.ribbon_draw: draw_on = [[t, fraction, easing]]: how much is drawn from tail to head (the head leads). erase = [[t, fraction, easing]]: how much is wiped from the tail toward the head. Visible length = draw_on - erase; nothing pops in or out.
verbs.orbit: centre (player, station or body n), radius (m), turns_per_second (Unity sense, + = counter-clockwise from above), start (s), rise (m per s), and optional angle_keys added on top. The ribbon turns about the vertical axis through its centre from start.
verbs.spiral: an orbit with rise > 0: the ribbon climbs while it turns.

conventions.scale: Stand-in enemies are 1.89 m tall, the size of the castle soldiers. Pieces were drawn to read at the game camera (12.7 m); keep their size relative to the body in game, not to the screen.
conventions.colour: Materials are flat emission in linear colour (the ramp ones shade by facing: centre to rim), except the toon stone, thorn (st_sl_thorn) and sword (st_sl_blade steel, st_sl_guard bronze, st_sl_grip leather: vfxsl_sword carries all three), which are lit toon with the ink outline. Poison's venom st_sl_venom is near-black green with a sickly-green rim (0.3, 0.6, 0.12 linear at its edge) so it reads on dark floors; Light's beams st_sl_beam are warm gold at the centre to amber at the rim. vfxsl_beam and vfxsl_crown are smooth-shaded. No stop reaches pure white: the strip maker counts pure-white pixels (all channels 250 or more) in every strip frame (slam/white_check.json): every look is 0.
conventions.moment: t 0 is the hammer head landing (the end of attack_hammer_2's 0.40 s windup). The patch and its cracks start at t 0; the hero bursts 0.07 s later. Lightning starts before it: its bolt strikes the raised head at t -0.13. Dark's pit forms at 0.14 s and bursts at 0.36 s. Each look lasts 1.4 s, then 0.5 s of settle in the renders.
conventions.carrier: The grey stand-in hammer in the renders (stk_hammer, role ref) is a mock-up of the blow only and is not in this recipe. Its handle is long enough that its head lands 2.5 m ahead of the player, on the game's slam spot (PlayerCombat.cs:1475). Nothing is drawn on the weapon: Lightning's bolt strikes the head (the owner's pick) and its sparks are thrown off it; nothing stays on it.
conventions.motion.body: The body (index into bodies) a piece belongs to, with about_body = its position from that body (Unity axes). Written from the pass's specs (slam/tools/slam_specs.py) by slam/tools/slam_assemble_recipe.py. Pieces about the impact carry at_impact instead. Ribbons on a body (Poison's veins, Lightning's jumps) have points relative to that body's ground point.
conventions.per_struck_enemy: motion.per_struck_enemy = true marks a piece that exists once for each enemy the slam actually reaches, placed about_body from that enemy; spawn one set per struck enemy and none on a miss. Bodies 0 and 1 are inside the disc (struck_bodies), body 2 is outside it (missed_bodies) and has nothing drawn on it. Such pieces: Dark (a burst of smoky darkness on each), Poison (the bruise and flat vein web) and Lightning (the charge jumping out of the cracks into each, with sparks). The rest of every look is about the impact.
conventions.look_fields: Each look carries element, moment (infused), strike_shape (slam), weapon, impact_player_relative ([a, c] in the station frame, metres), owner (the comment it answers, quoted), answer, look (in words), struck_bodies, missed_bodies and per_struck_enemy_pieces.
conventions.strike_shape: slam: the infused strike of the Great Hammer (attack_hammer_2, a disc of radius 1.5 m, 2.5 m ahead). A hammered-down patch of the element's ground (about 3.4 m across, its cracks running out 1.1 to 1.5 m from the impact like a star, never a ring) and ONE hero piece bursting from its centre. The arc looks (strikes_recipe.json) stay for the arc weapons.
conventions.dark_outline: Dark's smoke (vfxe2_cloud_a and _b in st_sl_shadow_smoke: near-black with a violet rim by facing) was rendered with the violet outline of the approved Dark strike's hands (Freestyle line set InkHands, 0.42, 0.18, 0.7 linear, thickness 1.5, silhouette and outer contour). In Unity give the smoke the same violet silhouette outline.
conventions.poison_veins: Poison's bruise, wound, vein web and sheen are ribbons whose points were snapped onto the stand-in body's surface and sunk into it so they lie flat on the skin (the bruise shows as a flat patch about 1.5 cm proud, the fine vessels as painted lines) and ride its motion (follow_body). In Unity build them as a decal or a vein and bruise mask in the enemy's shader that spreads from the wound with the same timing; nothing should stand out of the body.
conventions.revisions: 2026-11-21. Round 5b: the owner on Metal ("the sword is too big out of the ground now, I dont think the hilt should come all the way out of the ground"): vfxsl_sword is placed at 0.7 size and stops with its guard at the ground, grip and pommel buried, about 2.25 m of blade showing; the one glint still flares at the point. Round 5: the owner approved all eleven in concept ("the visuals in unity need to be well implemented") and asked for polish on five: Water is a crown-shaped splash wall that rises and falls (new vfxsl_crown) with a jet from its middle and droplets breaking off its points; Metal's blade became a sword driven up from below, with a guard and grip (vfxsl_sword); Poison's venom has a brighter sickly-green rim (st_sl_venom); Light is smooth beams (vfxsl_beam) and round gold motes, no spikes; Wind is ten fat, tight gusts instead of eighteen tendrils. The other six are as in round 4 (slam/r4/). Round 4, the owner on slam_all.png: Earth, Ice and Life approved and unchanged. Redone to the owner's picks: Fire (one big flame erupts and vanishes), Water (a big splash), Metal (a bigger, sharper forged blade with one blue-grey glint), Dark (implosion: shadows lurch in, a black pit, an uneven smoky burst), Wind (downdraft: low curls race out, dust and grit), Lightning (the hammer as conductor: a bolt on the head, the charge through the cracks into the struck), Light (light bleeds from the cracks, a short column bursts up from the ground), Poison (a venom geyser). The impact moved from 1.48 m to 2.5 m ahead (the game's slam spot); every look is drawn about the impact, so only the player's position changed for the three approved ones. Round 3: slam/r3/ (strips _r3, recipe, kit, notes, specs, blend).
